rows.ja: 電力の販売先(データセンター・AI)

relations.text: AEP Texasが年次報告で、主要な顧客としてNRGとVistraを挙げている(送配電サービスの提供)
relations.text_en: AEP Texas lists NRG and Vistra as its significant customers for delivery services

source.label: AEP 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Significant Customers of AEP Texas: NRG Energy and Vistra Corp 2025 2024 2023 Percentage of Total Revenues 38 %
source.note: NRGとVistraの合計で、AEP Texasの売上の38%(2025年)です。
source.note_en: NRG and Vistra are reported combined (38% of AEP Texas revenue in 2025).

relations.text: CenterPoint Houstonが年次報告で、Vistra関連会社を主要な外部顧客として記載
relations.text_en: CenterPoint Houston lists affiliates of Vistra as a major external customer

source.label: CenterPoint Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Affiliates of NRG $ 1,229 $ 1,169 $ 1,106 Affiliates of Vistra Energy Corp. 693 605 539
source.note: Vistraの小売電力会社への送配電サービスです。
source.note_en: Delivery services to Vistra’s retail electricity providers.

relations.text: PJMの原子力発電所から、2,609MWの電力・容量を供給する20年の電力購入契約
relations.text_en: 20-year PPAs to supply 2,609MW of carbon-free power and capacity from its PJM nuclear plants

source.label: Vistra 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we had entered into 20-year PPAs with Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta) to supply 2,609 MW of carbon-free power and capacity from our PJM nuclear power plants
source.note: 段階的に供給します。増強分(433MW)はこれから建設します。
source.note_en: Delivery is staged; the 433MW uprate capacity is still to be built.

relations.text: Comanche Peak原子力発電所から1,200MWを供給する20年の電力購入契約
relations.text_en: 20-year PPA to supply 1,200MW from the Comanche Peak nuclear plant

source.label: Vistra 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) (with options to extend for up to an additional 20 years) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to supply 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from our Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant
source.note: 供給開始は2027年第4四半期の見込みで、2032年までに全量に拡大します。
source.note_en: Delivery expected to begin in Q4 2027 and ramp to full capacity by 2032.

relations.text: Cipherが年次報告で、Odessa施設の電力をVistra子会社のLuminantから電力購入契約で調達と記載
relations.text_en: Cipher’s annual report says it buys power for its Odessa facility from Vistra subsidiary Luminant under a PPA

source.label: Cipher Digital 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In June 2021, we entered into a power purchase agreement with Luminant for the supply of electric power to the Odessa Facility
source.note: 契約の相手は子会社のLuminant ET Services Company LLCです。
source.note_en: The counterparty named is Luminant ET Services Company LLC.

relations.text: AI向け資産(データセンターなど)に投資するKKR運用のファンドへ出資を約束
relations.text_en: Committed to invest in a KKR-managed fund targeting AI-enabling assets such as data centers

source.label: Vistra 10-Q(2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: KKR Helix C L.P. (the Helix Fund), an open-ended investment fund managed by affiliates of KKR & Co. Inc. (KKR)
source.note: 最大10億ドルの約束で、初回5億ドルと追加5億ドルです。
source.note_en: Up to $1B: $500M initial plus $500M subject to conditions.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
